［评分刚出，会慢慢涨的］
轰隆！
雷声炸鸣，凄厉蜿蜒雷光映照下的场景，是无数弟子齐聚于太玄宗小竹峰前。
小竹峰，太玄宗八峰之一！
无数弟子纷纷跪地，叩首，而后拿出匕首！
他们所看向的，是一身穿青衣，此刻被瓢泼大雨浸透，面色苍白至极的绝美女子。
小竹峰峰主，苏婉卿！
“师尊，这是我们最后一次称呼您为师尊了！”
“您从今往后，已经没有资格教授我等.......”
有人开口，嗓音嘹亮，却无时无刻不在震颤着苏婉卿的内心。
此刻，她望着面前自己的诸多弟子，眼神中透露着失落和绝望，以及深深的不甘。
窒息感传遍全身，仿佛已经无法呼吸。
而在那无数跪地弟子身旁，则是几名层次修为极高的老者双手负后，一脸漠然，而雨水并未沾染这位强者的衣衫半点，没还落下就主动避让开来。
“苏婉卿，如今你修为尽失！”
“宗门已经给了你一个月的时间，可你修行重修之路毫无任何起色。”
“圣人雷劫，原本突破失败便是身死道消，你得天垂怜保全一条性命，可老夫之前说过什么？能活命已是极好！还妄图重修？”
“如今，约定之期已过，你当年所招收的诸多弟子，如今也不配教导！”
话落，跪地弟子之中，为首女子，乃是苏婉卿大弟子。

她声音中带着遗憾，起身拱手。
“师尊，修行界向来以实力为尊，早年我等敬重您为北域最具天赋的剑道修士，特意拜入宗门。”
“如今您修为尽失，只怕无力教导我等，如今宗门宗主念师尊多年功绩，愿意保留师尊小竹峰峰主身份，且愿意照顾师尊的后半生。”
“可我们，如今年纪尚且还小，还是宗门寄予期望的后代，唯愿更加拔高！”
“如今按照宗主要求，只得转投其他宗主门下，愧对师尊，在此谢罪！”
其余弟子也是纷纷开口。
“弟子等人愧对师尊，还望师尊成全我等！”
几位长老脸上也是带着笑容。
“诸多天骄弟子，如今不是你能教导的，莫要因你执念败落我宗门未来。”
“苏婉卿，你若今日直接答应，大家面子上都过得去，倘若不答应........”
“哼！”
众人视线中，那极美女子浑身都在颤抖着，脸色更加难看，已经是毫无血色！
凄厉泪光和那瓢泼大雨之下，那女子眼角的不知是雨水，还是泪水。
多年教授，如今门下弟子，竟然都要离开。
甚至只有一人关心过她如今的状态。
可这就是事实，正如这些弟子所说，修行界，以实力为尊。
她之前，为北域最具天赋的剑修。
年纪轻轻，便已达六境巅峰，即将突破圣人！
一旦入圣，就是古来今往突破最快的圣人，也是太玄宗除宗主之外的第二位圣人！
而正是因此，或许是追求突破速度更快，让她的道心失衡，而失去自身修为平衡。

因此突破失败，身受重伤！

Boom!
Thunder roared, and the scene illuminated by the shrill and winding thunder was countless disciples gathered in front of Taixuan Sect's Xiaozhu Peak.
Xiaozhu Peak, one of the eight peaks of Taixuan Sect!
Countless disciples knelt down, kowtowed, and then took out daggers!
What they were looking at was a beautiful woman wearing green clothes, her face soaked by the pouring rain, and her face was extremely pale.
Xiaozhu Peak Peak Master, Su Wanqing!
"Master, this is the last time we call you Master!"
"From now on, you are no longer qualified to teach us..."
Someone spoke with a loud voice, but it shook Su Wanqing's heart all the time.
At this moment, she looked at the many disciples in front of her, her eyes revealing loss, despair, and deep unwillingness.
A feeling of suffocation spread throughout his body, as if he could no longer breathe.
Beside the countless kneeling disciples, there were several old men with extremely high levels of cultivation, their hands behind their backs and expressions of indifference. The rain did not stain the strong man's clothes at all, and he took the initiative to get out of the way before it fell.
"Su Wanqing, now you have lost all your cultivation!"
"The sect has given you a month, but you have made no progress in your cultivation and reconstruction."
"Saint Thunder Tribulation, if you fail to break through, you will die. You are saved by God's mercy, but what did I say before? It's great to be alive! Are you still trying to rebuild?"
"Now, the agreed period has passed, and many of the disciples you recruited back then are no longer worthy of teaching!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the leading woman among the kneeling disciples was the eldest disciple Su Wanqing.
With regret in her voice, she stood up and held her hands.
"Master, the cultivation world has always respected strength. In the early years, we respected you as the most talented swordsman monk in the Northern Territory and specially worshiped you in the sect."
"Now that you have lost all your cultivation, I am afraid that you will not be able to teach us. Now the sect master remembers the master's achievements over the years, and is willing to retain the master's identity as the master of Xiaozhu Peak, and is willing to take care of the master for the rest of his life."
"But we are still young now, and we are still the descendants of the sect's expectations. We only hope to be even better!"
"Now, according to the request of the sect leader, I have to switch to another sect leader's sect. I am ashamed of my master, and I would like to apologize here!"
The other disciples also spoke one after another.
"Disciples and others are ashamed of our Master, and we hope that Master will help us!"
Several elders also had smiles on their faces.
"There are many talented disciples that you can't teach now. Don't let your obsession ruin the future of our sect."
"Su Wanqing, if you agree directly today, everyone will be better off. If you don't agree..."
"Hmph!"
In the sight of everyone, the extremely beautiful woman was trembling all over, her face became even more ugly, and she was already bloodless!
Under the shrill tears and the pouring rain, it was not clear whether it was rain or tears in the corner of the woman's eyes.
He has been a professor for many years, but now his disciples are all leaving.
Only one person even cared about her current state.
But this is the fact. As these disciples said, in the world of cultivation, strength is the most respected thing.
She was previously the most talented swordsman in the Northern Territory.
At a young age, he has already reached the peak of the Sixth Realm and is about to break through to become a saint!
Once you become a saint, you will be the saint with the fastest breakthrough in history, and the second saint in Taixuan Sect besides the sect leader!
And it is precisely because of this, perhaps the pursuit of a faster breakthrough, that made her Taoist mind unbalanced, and she lost the balance of her own cultivation.
Therefore, the breakthrough failed and he was seriously injured!
